name: April na Fool e no Shoutaijou
original_name: エイプリルなフールへの招待状
source:
Donna came to the city from the countryside to sort through her grandmother's belongings. Having grown accustomed to city life and the task of sorting through her grandmother's possessions, one morning, Donna expected a normal day to start, but what she saw was…!?

[Translated from the [url=https://dotaihen.xxxxxxxx.jp/teap/april.html]official website[/url]]
